models.name: GPT-4o
strengths: Strong multimodal capabilities (text, image, audio)
Excellent reasoning and instruction following
Fast inference speed compared to GPT-4 Turbo
Wide API ecosystem and tooling support
Strong coding and math performance
models.best_for: General-purpose assistant tasks, multimodal applications, enterprise deployments requiring reliable performance

models.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
strengths: Exceptional long-context understanding and recall
Strong coding and software engineering tasks
Nuanced writing and creative content generation
High safety and alignment standards
Best-in-class instruction following
models.best_for: Long document analysis, complex coding tasks, nuanced writing, and applications requiring high safety standards

models.name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
strengths: Industry-leading context window size
Strong multimodal support (text, image, video, audio, code)
Excellent performance on long-context retrieval tasks
Native integration with Google ecosystem
Competitive multilingual capabilities
models.best_for: Processing extremely long documents or codebases, video understanding, multimodal tasks, and Google ecosystem integration

models.name: Llama 3.1
strengths: Fully open-source weights available for download
Strong performance competitive with closed models
Available in multiple sizes (8B, 70B, 405B)
No vendor lock-in and full customization potential
Active open-source community and fine-tuning ecosystem
models.best_for: Organizations requiring data privacy, on-premise deployment, custom fine-tuning, or cost-sensitive high-volume applications

models.name: Mistral Large
strengths: Strong multilingual capabilities especially in European languages
Excellent reasoning and instruction following
Efficient performance relative to model size
Function calling and JSON mode support
Competitive pricing among frontier models
models.best_for: Multilingual applications, European market deployments, cost-efficient reasoning tasks, and function-calling workflows

models.name: Command R+
strengths: Purpose-built for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Strong grounded generation with citations
Excellent tool use and multi-step agent workflows
Optimized for enterprise search and knowledge applications
Multilingual support across 10+ languages
models.best_for: Enterprise RAG pipelines, knowledge management systems, grounded question answering, and multi-step agentic tasks

models.name: Grok-2
strengths: Real-time access to X (Twitter) data and internet
Strong reasoning and frontier benchmark performance
Multimodal image understanding capabilities
Less restrictive content policies for certain use cases
Competitive performance on coding and math benchmarks
models.best_for: Real-time information retrieval, social media analysis, applications requiring up-to-date knowledge, and less filtered creative tasks
